content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Amdar Shashikant Shinde Mahavidyalaya, Medha (Jayvant Pratishthan Humgaon), dated 19 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for Amdar Shashikant Shinde Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Amdar Shashikant Shinde Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Clock Hour Basis Teacher (Marathi).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Amdar Shashikant Shinde Mahavidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 26 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per Maharashtra Government norms for CHB teachers.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per UGC and Maharashtra Government norms for Assistant Professor (CHB).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The appointed teacher must submit an undertaking on stamp paper (as per government rules) of working in only one college at a time and not in any other college.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview through the local selection committee. Selection through the local selection committee at the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary appointment on clock hour basis (CHB) for the academic year 2026-27. Appointment for one academic year, maximum 09 months, ending automatically thereafter. No right of regular service; no claim to permanency or regular service in future.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Amdar Shashikant Shinde Mahavidyalaya, Medha, Tal. Jawali, Dist. Satara.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Application; Necessary original documents; Xerox copies of the documents.
